versions.content: Semantics of MacSecCipherSuiteConfig . cipherSuit- ePriority The MacSecCryptoAlgoConfig can define up to four MacSecCi- pherSuiteConfig s. If more then one MacSecCipherSuiteConfig is defined then the cipherSuitePriority decides about the chosen cipher. The cipherSuit- ePriority of value 1 means the highest priority and 4 means the lowest priority.
